title: Very Hot Day
note: 英文人工 SRT 与中文翻译逐条对齐；纯音效/水印行已剔除。

lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother George,
lines.zh: 我是佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，

lines.en: this is Mummy Pig, and this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
Very hot day.
The sun is shining. It is a very hot day.
lines.zh: 阳光明媚。这是一个非常热的一天。

lines.en: What a lovely hot day!
lines.zh: 多么可爱的炎热的一天啊！

lines.en: Peppa and George are wearing their boots. They are going to jump in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治穿着他们的靴子。他们要跳进泥坑里。

lines.en: I love muddy puddles.
Oh dear, the sun is so hot that the puddles have dried up.
lines.zh: 天哪，太阳这么大，泥坑都干了。

lines.en: Mummy, Daddy, the puddles are all dry and we can't jump in them.
lines.zh: 妈妈、爸爸，泥坑都干了，我们跳不进去。

lines.en: Never mind Peppa, it's so sunny you can play in the paddling pool instead.
lines.zh: 别管佩奇了，阳光这么好，你可以去戏水池里玩。

lines.en: Yes, the paddling pool.
First you have to change into your swimming costumes.
Yes Mummy.
Peppa and George are wearing their swimming costumes.
Mummy Pig is wearing her swimming costume.
And Daddy Pig is wearing his swimming costume.
Because it's so hot, you need sun cream.
lines.zh: 因为太热了，需要防晒霜。

lines.en: Yuck, so oily and yucky.
What a fuss about nothing.
Yes, we all need sun cream today.
lines.zh: 是的，今天我们都需要防晒霜。

lines.en: Come on George.
Let's get some air into this paddling pool.
lines.zh: 让我们到这个戏水池里呼吸一些空气。

lines.en: Daddy Pig is pumping up the paddling pool.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸正在给戏水池打水。

lines.en: Easy as pie.
Peppa holds the hose and Mummy Pig turns on the water.
lines.zh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪妈妈打开水。

lines.en: Where's the water?
Whoa!
Peppa and George love their paddling pool.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢他们的戏水池。

lines.en: Ice cream! Ice cream!
Miss Rabbit the ice cream lady!
Ice cream!
On very hot days Miss Rabbit sells ice cream.
lines.zh: 大热天兔小姐卖冰淇淋。

lines.en: Mummy, Daddy, can George and I have an ice cream please?
lines.zh: 妈妈、爸爸，我和乔治可以吃冰淇淋吗？

lines.en: Oh well, I suppose it is an especially hot day.
lines.zh: 哦，好吧，我想今天是特别热的一天。

lines.en: Hooray!
Please can I have one as well?
Everyone likes ice cream.
Hello Mummy Pig, Peppa and George.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈、佩奇和乔治你们好。

lines.en: Hello Miss Rabbit.
What ice creams would you like?
Can I have a cone please Miss Rabbit?
lines.zh: 兔小姐能给我一个甜筒吗？

lines.en: Of course you may Peppa.
Thank you.
The same for me and one for Daddy Pig please.
lines.zh: 我也一样，猪爸爸也一样。

lines.en: And what would young Mr George like?
lines.zh: 那么年轻的乔治先生会喜欢什么？

lines.en: Dinosaur!
A dinosaur?
Silly George.
He always says dinosaur for everything.
lines.zh: 他总是说一切都是恐龙。

lines.en: Well, it just so happens that I do have a dinosaur shaped ice lolly.
lines.zh: 嗯，碰巧我有一根恐龙形状的冰棍。

lines.en: Dinosaur!
George, you should eat your ice lolly before it melts.
lines.zh: 乔治，你应该在冰棒融化之前吃掉它。

lines.en: Dinosaur!
George loves his dinosaur ice lolly so much he doesn't want to eat it.
lines.zh: 乔治非常喜欢他的恐龙冰棍，以至于他不想吃它。

lines.en: Thank you Miss Rabbit.
Enjoy the weather!
George, I really think you should eat your ice lolly before it melts and...
lines.zh: 乔治，我真的认为你应该在冰棍融化之前吃掉它......

lines.en: falls on the ground.
Oh dear, George's dinosaur ice lolly has melted and fallen on the ground.
lines.zh: 天啊，乔治的恐龙冰棒融化掉在地上了。

lines.en: Never mind George, you can share Daddy's ice cream.
lines.zh: 别管乔治，你可以分享爸爸的冰淇淋。

lines.en: I'm sure he won't mind.
It is so warm Daddy Pig has fallen asleep.
Daddy Pig does look hot.
Let's take water on Daddy to cool him down.
lines.zh: 我们去给爸爸浇点水给他降温吧。

lines.en: Good idea Peppa.
What happened?
You were all red and hot Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 你们都是又红又热的猪爸爸。

lines.en: So we took water on you.
Oh, I see. Thank you Peppa.
Look, the puddles are back.
Quick George, let's get our boots.
lines.zh: 快点乔治，我们穿上靴子吧。

lines.en: Peppa and George are wearing their boots.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治穿着他们的靴子。

lines.en: Peppa and George love the hot day, but most of
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢炎热的天气，但大多数人

lines.en: all they love jumping up and down in puddles.
lines.zh: 他们都喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

lines.en: Peppa Pig.
Peppa Pig.
Peppa Pig.
